basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.label: First-year PhD candidate
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with specific interests in LLM Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning, Hallucination in Vision-Language Models (VLM), and LLM truthfulness and Interpretability.
